description: Features as a list of disclosures, the first one open, with an optional picture.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Features as a list of disclosures: icon and title in the summary, the text when open. Axes: expand (first: the
  first one is open, none: all closed), media (none, image: a picture beside the list), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

export type FeatureAccordionProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  features: Feature[];
  empty?: string;
  expand?: "first" | "none";
  media?: "none" | "image";
  multiple?: boolean;
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Disclosure from "../compose/Disclosure.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Summary from "../compose/Summary.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  features,
  empty = "",
  expand = "first",
  media = "none",
  multiple = false,
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<FeatureAccordionProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    :layout="(((media as string) === 'image') ? 'split' : 'stack')"
    :media="{ show: ((media as string) === 'image') }"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <EmptyState v-if="((features?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="layout-grid" :title="empty" />
    <Stack v-else gap="0" align="stretch" data-slot="items">
      <Disclosure v-for="(f, i) in features" :key="f.id"
        variant="item"
        :name="(multiple ? undefined : tpl('{0}-accordion', (id ?? 'accordion')))"
        :open="(((expand as string) === 'first') && (i === 0))"
        data-slot="item"
      >
        <Summary variant="item">
          <Inline class="flex min-w-0 items-center justify-start gap-4">
            <LucideIcon :name="f.icon" :size="20" />
            <Inline class="text-base font-semibold">
              {{ f.title }}
            </Inline>
          </Inline>
        </Summary>
        <Text size="sm" class="pb-4 text-muted-foreground">
          {{ f.text }}
        </Text>
      </Disclosure>
    </Stack>
    <template #aside>
      <MediaFrame :alt="title" ratio="4/3" />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
